Free front end

Every new lead costs before it pays

A free training is a great way in, but if you put ad spend behind it, the money only comes back weeks later, if at all. There’s nothing that pays for the click on the same day.

Products off to the side

Your paid doors sit on separate pages

Your $99 and $149 courses and the $29 Academy live on their own pages, not at the moment someone signs up for a free training. A listener who wants a quick, one-off fix for their money has nowhere obvious to say yes, so they leave and come back to the free content.

DM qualification

Your time does the filtering

“DM ME COACH” means every curious follower lands in your inbox first. You end up qualifying people one message at a time instead of meeting buyers who already raised their hand.

Huge reach, a trusted voice, and nothing in place that pays you on the day someone first says yes.

A $27 Money Autopilot Kit, with an order bump, your Academy as the upsell, and an application at the end

Questions

Before you grab the kit

Do I need to be good with money already?

No. The kit starts with mapping what you have today, wherever that is.

Will you tell me what to invest in?

No. The kit is education. It explains the Portfolio Pyramid framework so you understand the options. It isn’t personal financial advice.

How long does it take?

Most of the set-up fits in one weekend. After that, a 15-minute monthly check-in.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Set up the system, then decide if you want to go deeper inside the Academy.
